caveats: Thresholds/climatology from 1992-2002 baseline day-of-year pools, where each pool includes every SST value within +/-5 calendar days of a baseline date; per the method this extends to buffer days 1991-12-27..1991-12-31 and 2003-01-01..2003-01-05. 90th percentile computed with numpy method='hazen' (MATLAB quantile default, Hyndman-Fan type 5); day-60 values set to the mean of days 59 and 61 before a 31-day centred circular moving mean. Region resolved on the dataset's 0.02 deg grid: lat 64.40-65.58 N, lon 23.42-24.60 E (3600 cells, 3311 sea cells finite on all 92 target days). Hot-day test: SST in kelvin (float32 as stored, compared in float64) >= cell threshold for that day of year.
